result.title: Receiver-Resolution APS-PDP Maps for Wireless Channels: Benchmarking and Coarse-to-Fine Modeling
result.summary: Angle Power Spectrum (APS) and Power Delay Profile (PDP) are receiver-facing spectra that govern beam selection and wideband equalization. Most ray-tracing benchmarks provide supervision as variable-size multipath component lists. This format does not match practical receivers, whose angular and delay resolutions are limited by array aperture and system bandwidth. As a result, learning targets are ambiguous and evaluations can change with reconstruction conventions. We introduce UrbanADPSMap, a benchmark that converts ray-traced supervision into fixed-grid APS and PDP targets by explicitly modeling bandwidth-limited and aperture-limited response kernels. By fixing the receiver-domain kernels, discretization, and validity mask, UrbanADPSMap removes reconstruction-induced target ambiguity and stabilizes downstream evaluation across methods. Built on this benchmark, we propose SpecFlowAR, a coarse-to-fine generator based on multi-scale autoregressive flow matching. The model first captures coarse dispersion structure and then refines beam-relevant peaks and low-power tails. The number of function evaluations controls the sampling budget, enabling latency and quality to be adjusted for dense spectrum queries. Experiments on the test set show that SpecFlowAR reduces BPL@5 to 2.03 dB under a unified NFE=80 budget, while improving beam utility and reducing errors of 3GPP dispersion statistics.

AI.brief_summary: 论文提出 UrbanADPSMap 基准，显式建模带宽与孔径受限的接收端响应核，把射线追踪监督转为固定网格的 APS/PDP 目标以消除重建歧义；并给出 SpecFlowAR，用多尺度自回归 flow matching 先捕捉粗粒度弥散结构、再细化波束相关峰值与低功率尾部，以 NFE 控制采样预算，在 NFE=80 下降低 BPL@5 等误差。
AI.relevance_reason: 与视觉推理主线无直接关系，但其「粗到细」多尺度自回归 flow matching 以及用 NFE 显式调节质量—延迟的采样预算机制，可能为 LVR 中 latent 状态的并行/迭代生成与动态计算分配提供方法线索，可供核查其是否适用于推理状态更新与成本控制。
